rows.name: Tata Consultancy Services Limited
rows.remarksWeb: 1.The Company is a subsidiary of Tata Sons Private Limited (TSPL) which holds 71.74% in the Company as on June 30, 2026. TSPL is a Core Investment Company and as an investment vehicle, it is exempted from the Company's (Significant Beneficial Owners) Rules, 2018 (SBO Rules) on investment made by it. The Company does not have any other Significant Beneficial Owner as per the SBO Rules. 2. The list of Promoter and Promoter group companies do not include subsidiaries of the Company. 3. PT TQCert Indonesia became a part of the promoter group w.e.f. May 26, 2026. 4. TComm Turkey Dijital Cozumler Limited Sirketi became a part of the promoter group w.e.f. May 21, 2026. 5. TQ Cert Services LLC, Qatar became a part of the promoter group w.e.f. May 5, 2026. 6. Smart Value Homes (New Project) LLP ceased to be a part of promoter group w.e.f. June 16, 2026. 7. TSBB Voice Private Limited ceased to be a part of promoter group w.e.f. May 12, 2026. 8. Name of IAC Group (Slovakia) s.r.o. has been changed to Artifex Systems Slovakia s. r. o. w.e.f. April 17, 2026. 9. Name of Tata International West Asia DMCC has been changed to Tata International West Asia FZCO w.e.f. June 29, 2026.

source: NSE corporate-announcements + NSE PIT + NSE shareholding pattern
